node: HVDC reactors, high-voltage power equipment, and grid power-quality components
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for the HVDC/high-voltage components node with a two-lane funnel. The direct US-listed pure-play HVDC reactor universe appears thin; the more investable US lane is adjacent: transmission-line hardware, utility/substation components, custom switchgear/power-control systems, and testing/diagnostics gates. Hubbell is included as a reference anchor, while PLPC, POWL, and ESE are underfollowed or less obvious second-order candidates. None of these should be treated as a confirmed pure HVDC-reactor supplier without further customer/product verification.
